Isolotto Sud — Florence, Italy

🟡 Local press research

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

The Isolotto public-housing district (Quartiere 4) has seen genuine, serious documented incidents in 2025-2026: an armed confrontation between rival groups with several shots fired in a piazza (described by press as part of an ongoing 'gang war'), a robbery/theft arrest of a 55-year-old, and, most seriously, a 2026 knife attack on a father in front of his 10-year-old son during a street robbery attempt. Local press generally refers to these as happening 'at the Isolotto' without distinguishing between the Nord and Sud administrative sub-zones, so this rating is applied to both with that caveat noted honestly. Sources checked: La Nazione, 'Firenze, follia maranza: agguato con la pistola, sei spari in piazza' (Isolotto); ANSA Toscana, robbery arrest at Isolotto (July 2025); Il Fatto Quotidiano, father stabbed by baby gang in front of son at Isolotto (April 2026).
